with the Publisher toolchain the manifest records" } . derivedInputsthe content of the IG's inputs as `ig-ast.ts digest` reads them (tree-scoped, never commit-scoped: a merge, rebase or README-only commit leaves the key alone), plus the Publisher toolchain the manifest records; the branch name is keyed by the IG's package id, never by a hand list of files holdsthe IG Publisher's AST export (output-ast/: manifest.json and one JSON file per resource) and the Publisher's terminology cache (input-cache/txcache/) producerfhir-harness ig-ast-refresh.yml, step 'Seed the AST cache' (`ig-cache.sh seed --ig-root . --push`) on the Java runner, after a full IG Publisher build with the AST exporter; that dispatch is this cache's own save path (process Process_IgAstCache, Task_Export then Task_Seed) consumers[ "the IG site build (`ig-repo-site.ts` via stage-local, Process_IgAstCache Task_Restore then Task_BuildSite)", "ig-ast-refresh.yml's own restore, which skips the Publisher build when the restored AST is valid", "build-ig-indexes and stage-ast-sites, which list the branches but restore only for an IG they build" ] . materializes[ "output-ast/", "input-cache/txcache/" ] . stateInputs{ "reads": "unmeasured", "how": "not yet derived from a recorded read set; the producer may read state:mount graphs" } . needs[ "layers-ref" ] . refresh{ "mode": "incremental", "how": "over a STALE cache, ig-ast-refresh.yml runs IncrementalBuildCli (the AST delta, skill ig-ast-delta) on the Java runner and keeps its result only when `validity` passes; a failed or invalid delta, a release, or `force` builds in full" } . savePolicydefault branch only: seeded when the built commit is an ancestor of the default branch's tip and sushi-config.yaml, ig.ini and input/ are the same at both (Process_IgAstCache GW_Seedable); any other ref keeps its AST as a run artifact and leaves the cache alone verify`ig-cache.sh verify` runs `ig-ast.ts validity`: the digest of the IG's inputs now (or as committed at `--at <rev>`) against the manifest's inputs.inputDigest. Exit 0 valid, 1 stale-inputs (naming the input), 2 cannot-tell; anything but valid is a miss, so a bad entry costs a rebuild and is never built from ownerfhir-harness (skill ig-build-pipeline, "The AST cache lifecycle") uses[ "scripts/ig-cache.sh:204 cmd_restore", "scripts/ig-cache.sh:314 cmd_seed", "scripts/ig-cache.sh:413 cmd_verify (validity, then the cached-step line)", "scripts/ig-ast.ts:350 cachedStepLine (hit/warm/miss)", "scripts/ig-ast.ts:395 astValidity", "scripts/ig-repo-site.ts:376 the site build's restore", ".github/workflows/ig-ast-refresh.yml:163-168 restore, validity and the cached-step line", ".github/workflows/ig-ast-refresh.yml:284 warm: the line after a valid incremental build", ".github/workflows/ig-ast-refresh.yml:393 seed", "scripts/stage-ast-sites.ts:98 lists the branches", "processes/content/ig-ast-cache.bpmn" ] . notesRestored only by steps that build or render an IG (owner, 2026-11-05: "not all rendering/CI/merge processes need all caches. be optimal"): never by a test shard, a gate or a merge job. Process_IgAstCache is this cache's component process; Process_Cache (cat-harness) draws it as a task in its own lane, since a lower layer cannot call into this one: Task_Restore and GW_Valid are its verify, Task_Seed its save. The old `cat-fhir-ast/` and `fhir-ast/` branch names are retired (bean oycs), so they are not read. Every restore and refresh prints one line in cached-step's format: `**cached-step `ig-ast`: hit|warm|miss** (exact) — <why>. Key `<input digest>`.`

10cce6a4bcf3.doc: Prepared CI image: mounted layers, node_modules and Chromium — cache
10cce6a4bcf3.title: Fields
10cce6a4bcf3.content: $schemacache/1.0.0 idci-image titlePrepared CI image: mounted layers, node_modules and Chromium instancecat-harness-tools kindghcr-image trustClassa locationghcr.io/<owner>/<repo>-ci of the INDEX repository (folio-assistant: ghcr.io/litlfred/folio-assistant-ci), tag = key keyRecipe{ "source": "script", "implementation": ".github/ci-image/key.sh", "expression": "sha256(index.lock.json, bun.lock, package.json, every file under .github/ci-image and .github/actions/ci-setup sorted by path, bun --version, $ImageOS uname -m)" } . derivedInputsEverything the image holds is a function of the key's inputs: the lock pins every mounted layer and its tree digest; bun.lock and package.json fix node_modules and through them Playwright's Chromium build; the recipe files fix how it is laid out; bun and the runner OS fix native modules. State branches are excluded by construction (prepare.sh strips every state-mount marker's directory). holdsSeven zstd layers in a FROM-scratch image: five workspace layers (every instance index.lock.json mounts, plus node_modules split by package and balanced by size) and two Playwright browser layers. The label ci-image.layers names each layer's role (ws|pw). No secrets: public repos at locked commits, and npm through bun.lock. producer.github/workflows/ci-image.yml job publish (push to main touching the key's inputs, or workflow_dispatch); recipe .github/ci-image/build.sh → prepare.sh → docker buildx (zstd, provenance off); skips when the key's tag already exists consumers[ ".github/actions/ci-setup (fast path), called by 13 Code-quality-gates jobs and Feature Staging's stage (folio-assistant#2964)" ] . materializes[ "<instance>/ for every instance in index.lock.json", "node_modules/", "~/.cache/ms-playwright/ (only when chromium != none)" ] . needs[ "layers-ref" ] . refresh{ "mode": "whole", "how": "A new key is a new tag, built once on main; tags are never rewritten. A missing tag costs time only: ci-setup falls back to the mount cache, mount-from-lock (which tries layers-ref first) and bun install." } . savePolicymain or dispatch only (packages: write in the publish job alone); PR runs build into a throwaway local registry and never push verifyfetch.sh hashes each layer's bytes while they stream and compares them with the manifest digest; then mount:lock:check re-hashes every mounted directory against the committed lock. Either failing → partial files removed, fallback path. ownerCI speed 9 (bean folio-assistant-ay33); after the move, cat-harness-tools' shared ci-setup uses[ ".github/actions/ci-setup/action.yml:61 key", ".github/actions/ci-setup/action.yml:77 fetch", ".github/actions/ci-setup/action.yml:82 verify", ".github/workflows/ci-image.yml publish job", ".github/ci-image/build.sh" ] . notesPaths are folio-assistant's (#2961, branch claude/ci-image). Measured on a runner (run 42024357472): restore + mount:lock:check + bun install + Chromium launch = 7 s, against ~35 s of setup per job before (CQG run 42012108138). System libraries for Chromium (apt fonts) cannot be carried by a file image; `chromium: with-deps` still runs apt. Private package: consumers pass registry-token with packages: read (owner default, option 2). Hit/miss and why go to each job's step summary. stateInputs{ "reads": "none", "how": "by construction: prepare.sh strips every state-mount marker's directory before the layers are built" } .
